description: Who watched a recording and how far: opens, unique viewers, plays, average completion, retention, viewers by name, breakdowns. Pro feature; a free account gets gated:true with the totals only. Needs analytics:read.

id.description: The recording's public id (the slug in its share URL, e.g. 'a1b2c3d4e5f6') or the full https://clipy.online/video/<id> URL.

rangeDays.description: Days in the daily series (default 30). Every other figure is lifetime.
